'''Jedi Pack''' is the 9th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in April 1996. It is a free promotional pack of 11 common cards (5 Light, 5 Dark, plus the Hyperoute Navigation Chart game aid) with a promotional booklet. CardGuide lists 10 cards (the game aid is sometimes omitted). Distributed one per customer.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>
